taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.source_trace: Record exact proxy/backend versions, protocol conversions, framing rules, connection reuse and any normalization layer. Establish the two parsers' interpretations before a probe.
controls.controlled_verification: Prefer an isolated replica with two controlled requests on a dedicated connection and explicit frontend/backend logs. Use an inert canary to observe an actual message-boundary disagreement and which backend request consumes it. Bound bytes/time and terminate the fixture connection.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A timeout, 400 or duplicate framing header is not proof of desynchronization. No shared connection or consistent parser rejection may defeat the proposed chain. A single mock parser does not validate a real proxy stack.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use supported consistent framing/rejection across the actual stack and eliminate the evidenced ambiguous boundary. Retest ordinary persistent requests and the exact prior parser disagreement.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
